Web DLP Rule Resource Delete Rule
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/webDlpRules/:ruleId

Deletes a DLP policy rule. This endpoint is not applicable to SaaS Security API DLP policy rules.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the DLP policy rule.

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
